nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Core type definitions and data structures for ThreatDeck. Defines all enums (FeedType, FeedStatus, Criticality, KeywordMatchType, NotificationChannel, AlertStatus, AlertDisposition, Screen) and structs (Feed, ApiTemplate, Keyword, Alert, FeedItem, Tag, NotificationConfig, FeedHealthLog, AlertWithMeta, FeedWithTags, FeedItemWithFeed, FeedResult, FetchedFeedItem, NewFeedItem, AlertFilter, AlertTriageEvent, FeedItemFilter, MatchResult, EmailConfig, WebhookConfig, DiscordConfig, DiscordEmbed, Stats, FeedForm, KeywordForm, TagForm, NotificationForm, NotificationType, ConfirmDialog, SettingsTab, TagAssignmentTarget, TriageEnumTarget, TriageInputTarget). All UI components and business logic depend on these types.

nodes.name: FeedType
nodes.summary: Enum representing the type of threat intelligence feed: Api, Rss, Website, or Onion. Implements Display and From<&str> for parsing.

nodes.name: FeedStatus
nodes.summary: Enum representing feed health status: Healthy, Warning, Error, or Disabled. Feed uses this to determine health display.

nodes.name: Criticality
nodes.summary: Enum for alert severity levels: Low, Medium, High, Critical. Used throughout the application for prioritization.

nodes.name: AlertStatus
nodes.summary: Enum for alert triage lifecycle: New, Acknowledged, Investigating, Escalated, Closed.

nodes.name: AlertDisposition
nodes.summary: Enum for alert disposition outcomes: Unknown, ConfirmedThreat, FalsePositive, Benign, Duplicate, Informational, NeedsMoreContext.

nodes.name: Screen
nodes.summary: Enum representing the 10 TUI screens: Dashboard, Feeds, Alerts, Articles, Indicators, EnrichmentQueue, Keywords, Tags, Logs, Settings.

nodes.name: Feed
nodes.summary: Core Feed struct with id, name, url, feed_type, enabled flag, interval_secs, last_fetch timestamps, error tracking, consecutive_failures counter, content_hash, api_template_id, api_key, custom_headers, and tor_proxy. Includes health_status() method that checks consecutive_failures and enabled state.

nodes.name: ApiTemplate
nodes.summary: JSONPath extraction template for API feeds: jsonpath_title, jsonpath_description, jsonpath_date, jsonpath_url, jsonpath_source, and optional pagination_config.

nodes.name: Alert
nodes.summary: Alert struct with triage fields: id, feed_id, keyword_id, title, content_snippet, criticality, read, content_hash, detected_at, status, disposition, severity_override, confidence_score, owner, triage_notes, and timestamps for acknowledge/investigate/escalate/close lifecycle. Includes effective_severity(), is_open(), and can_close() methods.

nodes.name: Keyword
nodes.summary: Keyword struct with pattern, is_regex, case_sensitive, criticality, enabled, and created_at. Includes match_type() method.

nodes.name: FeedResult
nodes.summary: Result container from a feed fetch: content_hash, Vec<FetchedFeedItem>, and raw_content.

nodes.name: FetchedFeedItem
nodes.summary: Individual item from a feed fetch: title, description, date, url, source, and raw_json.

nodes.name: Stats
nodes.summary: Dashboard statistics: total_feeds, total_alerts, total_keywords, unread_alerts, healthy_feeds, warning_feeds, error_feeds, disabled_feeds.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Application configuration loading and saving via TOML. Defines AppConfig (theme, alert_retention_days, dashboard_refresh_secs, tick_rate_ms, max_health_log_entries), sub-configs (IocConfig, EnrichmentConfig, TriageConfig, AutoFetchConfig, ReportConfig), and Paths struct for config/data directory resolution using directories crate. Provides load_app_config() and save_app_config() functions. Includes tests for TOML parsing and defaults.

nodes.name: AppConfig
nodes.summary: Root application configuration struct with serde defaults. Fields: theme, alert_retention_days, dashboard_refresh_secs, tick_rate_ms, max_health_log_entries, ioc, enrichment, triage, auto_fetch, reports.

nodes.name: Paths
nodes.summary: Resolved paths for config_dir, data_dir, config_file, and db_file. Uses directories crate ProjectDirs. Includes ensure_dirs() method to create directories.

nodes.name: alert.rs
nodes.summary: Alert processing engine. AlertEngine struct with process_feed_result and process_feed_result_with_config methods that match keywords against feed items, deduplicate via SHA-256 content hashing (1-hour window), extract IOCs via sentinel-ioc, and queue enrichment jobs. Includes helper functions extraction_fields_for_item(), limit_indicators(), and truncate_chars(). Full test coverage for item storage, IOC extraction/linking, and enrichment queueing.

nodes.name: AlertEngine
nodes.summary: Core alert processing engine. process_feed_result() matches keywords against feed content, deduplicates via SHA-256 hash with 1-hour window, extracts IOCs with sentinel-ioc, stores alerts, links IOCs, and queues enrichment jobs. process_feed_result_with_config() uses AppConfig to control IOC extraction and enrichment behavior.

nodes.name: enrichment.rs
nodes.summary: Enrichment worker that processes queued IOC enrichment jobs using multiple providers. EnrichmentWorker manages HashMap of provider name to provider arc. Supports CisaKevProvider (loads from cisa-kev.json cache file) and UrlHausProvider. Handles rate limiting per provider, job claiming, result storage, and job status updates. Includes run_enrichment_once() for CLI --enrich-once mode. Full test coverage for provider registration, rate limiting, job retry logic, and CISA KEV cache loading.

nodes.name: EnrichmentWorker
nodes.summary: Enrichment worker managing multiple providers (CisaKevProvider, UrlHausProvider). new() creates from provider list. from_cache_dir() loads cisa-kev.json and adds UrlHaus. process_pending() claims jobs from DB, respects per-provider rate limits, calls provider.enrich(), stores results, and updates job status (succeeded/failed/rate_limited).

nodes.name: feed/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Feed module dispatcher. Defines the FeedFetcher trait, FeedManager struct, and FeedFetchOutcome. Routes fetch requests to the appropriate fetcher (ApiFetcher, RssFetcher, WebFetcher, OnionFetcher) based on FeedType. Provides run_fetch_attempt wrapper for diagnostics.

nodes.name: FeedManager::fetch_feed
nodes.summary: Selects the appropriate fetcher based on FeedType and delegates to it. Returns a boxed dyn FeedFetcher for Api, Rss, Website, or Onion feed types.

nodes.name: FeedManager::run_fetch_attempt
nodes.summary: Wraps fetch_feed with URL validation, timing, and error classification. Returns FeedFetchOutcome containing result or FetchAttempt diagnostic on failure.

nodes.name: FeedManager
nodes.summary: Central feed dispatch manager. Selects and delegates to feed-type-specific fetchers at runtime via a trait object.

nodes.name: FeedFetchOutcome
nodes.summary: Result wrapper combining a FeedResult (on success) with a FetchAttempt diagnostic record (always). Used by FeedManager::run_fetch_attempt.

nodes.name: feed/api.rs
nodes.summary: JSON API feed fetcher. ApiFetcher implements FeedFetcher, makes HTTP GET requests with optional Bearer/API-key auth and custom headers. Uses TemplateEngine for JSONPath extraction; falls back to common field names (title, data, items, results, posts).

nodes.name: ApiFetcher
nodes.summary: FeedFetcher implementation for API sources. Holds an optional ApiTemplate. Adds Authorization, X-API-Key headers and custom headers from JSON config. Parses response as JSON and extracts items via TemplateEngine or fallback field scanning.

nodes.name: feed/rss.rs
nodes.summary: RSS/Atom feed fetcher. RssFetcher implements FeedFetcher using the rss crate to parse RSS 2.0 and Atom feeds from HTTP responses. Extracts title, description, link, pubDate, and source name from each item.

nodes.name: RssFetcher
nodes.summary: FeedFetcher implementation for RSS/Atom feeds. Uses the rss crate to parse feed items and extract title, description, link, pubDate, and source channel title.

nodes.name: feed/web.rs
nodes.summary: Website HTML scraper fetcher. WebFetcher implements FeedFetcher using the scraper crate to parse HTML and extract all body text. Returns a single FetchedFeedItem with the cleaned text content (first 500 chars) for keyword matching.

nodes.name: WebFetcher
nodes.summary: FeedFetcher implementation for HTML websites. Uses scraper to extract body text from the page for keyword matching. Returns cleaned text as a single feed item.

nodes.name: feed/onion.rs
nodes.summary: Tor/.onion site fetcher. OnionFetcher implements FeedFetcher using ureq with a SOCKS5 proxy (via Privoxy). Configurable tor_proxy field; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8118. 120s timeout. Returns cleaned text content.

nodes.name: OnionFetcher
nodes.summary: FeedFetcher implementation for .onion sites via Tor. Uses ureq with a configured SOCKS5 proxy. 120-second timeout. Returns cleaned body text as a single feed item.

nodes.name: feed/diagnostics.rs
nodes.summary: Feed fetch diagnostics. Defines FetchFailurePhase (11 phases), FetchFailureKind (14 kinds), FetchDiagnostic, and FetchAttempt structs. Provides classifiers: classify_http_status, classify_transport_error, classify_body_error, classify_parse_error, classify_anyhow_error.

nodes.name: FetchFailurePhase
nodes.summary: Enum representing the HTTP/network phase in which a feed fetch failed. Values: UrlValidation, Dns, TcpConnect, TlsHandshake, HttpRequest, HttpStatus, Redirect, BodyDownload, ContentDecode, FeedParse, DatabaseWrite, Unknown.

nodes.name: FetchFailureKind
nodes.summary: Enum classifying the type of failure: InvalidUrl, DnsResolutionFailed, ConnectionRefused, ConnectionTimeout, TlsCertificateInvalid, TlsHandshakeFailed, HttpStatusClientError, HttpStatusServerError, TooManyRedirects, BodyReadFailed, InvalidXml, InvalidJson, InvalidRss, DatabaseError, Unknown.

nodes.name: FetchDiagnostic
nodes.summary: Structured diagnostic record: phase, kind, summary, detail, http_status, url, final_url, elapsed_ms. Produced by classifiers and stored in FetchAttempt.

nodes.name: FetchAttempt
nodes.summary: Record of a single feed fetch attempt. Fields: id, feed_id, attempted_at, success, url, final_url, http_status, elapsed_ms, diagnostic, items_seen, items_new.

nodes.name: feed/utils.rs
nodes.summary: Feed utility functions. Currently exports hash_content: computes SHA-256 hex digest of string content using sha2 + hex crates. Used for content deduplication across all feed types.

nodes.name: src/ui/mod.rs

nodes.name: draw_stats

nodes.name: stat_text
nodes.summary: Formats a stat value and optional sub-label. If sub is empty returns just the value string, otherwise returns 'value\nsub' for two-line display in stat boxes.

nodes.name: handle_form_key

nodes.name: handle_form_normal_mode
nodes.summary: Normal mode form keyboard handler. Tab/BackTab moves between fields, i/Enter enters typing mode on text fields, Space toggles enabled, arrows/Enter cycle feed type, Esc closes form, direct char input starts typing.

nodes.name: handle_form_typing_mode

nodes.name: submit_feed_form

nodes.name: src/ui/alerts.rs

Integrates IOC indicator panel showing enriched indicators per alert.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Main alerts screen draw function. Renders filter/criticality/status bar, alert table with colored severity indicators, and conditional overlays for detail view, enum selector, note input, and triage history.

nodes.name: draw_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the alert detail popup with three panels: metadata (title, criticality, feed, keyword, detected, read, tags, snippet), triage panel (status, disposition, severity, confidence, owner, notes, timestamps), and IOC indicator panel.

nodes.name: draw_triage_panel
nodes.summary: Renders the triage sub-panel of the alert detail view showing status, disposition, effective severity, confidence score, owner, triage notes, and status change timestamps.

nodes.name: draw_indicator_panel
nodes.summary: Renders the IOC indicator panel of the alert detail view as a table showing type, normalized value (truncated), sighting count, and enrichment reputation for up to 6 indicators.

nodes.name: draw_enum_selector
nodes.summary: Renders a popup for quick triage selection (status, disposition, or severity) with numbered items 1-9.

nodes.name: draw_note_input

nodes.name: draw_history
nodes.summary: Renders the triage history popup showing all status change events for an alert with timestamps, old→new values, and notes.

nodes.name: handle_key
nodes.summary: Alerts keyboard handler. Routes to triage enum/note handlers when active. Handles r (toggle read), R (mark all read), d (delete), b (bulk mode), t (tag assignment), Enter (detail), / (filter), c (cycle criticality filter), A/I/E/C/O (status changes), N/M (note/owner input), s/S/T (triage enum select), H (history view), h (hide closed).

nodes.name: handle_bulk_key
nodes.summary: Handles keyboard input in bulk delete mode: Space toggles selection, a selects all, d confirms deletion, Esc exits bulk mode.

nodes.name: handle_enum_select_key
nodes.summary: Handles triage enum selector input: number keys 0-9 select an option, Esc cancels. Updates alert status/disposition/severity in the database.

nodes.name: handle_note_input_key
nodes.summary: Handles note/owner input: Backspace deletes, Esc cancels, Enter saves note or owner to database, character keys append.

nodes.name: indicator_type_label

nodes.name: truncate_chars

nodes.name: src/ui/articles.rs

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Main articles screen draw function. Renders filter bar, article table with read indicators and dates, status bar, and conditionally renders the article reader overlay.

nodes.name: draw_reader

nodes.name: draw_article_indicators
nodes.summary: Renders the IOC indicator panel for an article showing type, normalized value, enrichment reputation, and sighting count for up to 5 indicators.

nodes.name: handle_key
nodes.summary: Articles keyboard handler. Routes to reader handler when reader is active. Handles Enter (open article), r (toggle read), u (toggle unread-only filter), / (filter).

nodes.name: open_selected_article
nodes.summary: Opens the selected article for reading. If the cached article has no full text, fetches it via article::fetch_article_text and caches it. Marks article as read and opens the reader.

nodes.name: clean_article_text
nodes.summary: Cleans article HTML text by decoding common HTML entities ( , &, <, >, ", '), stripping all HTML tags, and normalizing whitespace.

nodes.name: indicator_type_label
nodes.summary: Maps sentinel_ioc IndicatorType enum to human-readable short labels (e.g. Ipv4→IPv4, MitreAttackTechnique→MITRE).

nodes.name: truncate_chars
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to at most max_chars characters, appending '...' if truncation occurred. Never splits multibyte characters.

nodes.name: keywords.rs
nodes.summary: TUI screen for managing keyword patterns with criticality levels. Renders a table of keywords with pattern, match type, case sensitivity, criticality, enabled state, and tags. Supports add/edit/delete form overlay, pattern test mode, and keyboard navigation with vim-style bindings.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders the keywords screen: title bar, keyword table with row highlighting, and status bar. Delegates form overlay and test overlay rendering to helper functions.

nodes.name: handle_key
nodes.summary: Routes keyboard events for the keywords screen. Handles navigation (j/k/g/G), add (a/n), edit (e), delete (d), test (t), toggle enabled (Space/Enter), tag assignment (T), and filter (/).

nodes.name: draw_form
nodes.summary: Renders centered modal form for adding/editing a keyword. Fields: pattern (text input), match type (toggle: simple/regex), case sensitivity (toggle), criticality (cycle: Low/Medium/High/Critical), and enabled (toggle). Shows keyboard hints contextually based on input mode.

nodes.name: submit_keyword_form
nodes.summary: Validates and saves the keyword form to the database. Uses KeywordCreate for new keywords and KeywordUpdate for edits. Refreshes the keywords list and shows a success/error notification.

nodes.name: cycle_criticality
nodes.summary: Cycles keyword criticality level forward or backward through [Low, Medium, High, Critical]. Used by the criticality form field when user presses arrows, Enter, or Space.

nodes.name: tags.rs
nodes.summary: TUI screen for managing color-coded tags. Renders a table of tags showing name, color swatch (██), description, and usage count. Supports add/edit/delete via centered form overlay with name, hex color, and description fields.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders the tags screen: title bar with filter status, tags table with color swatches, and status bar. Delegates form overlay rendering to draw_form().

nodes.name: handle_key
nodes.summary: Routes keyboard events for the tags screen. Handles navigation (j/k), add (a/n), edit (e), delete (d), filter (/), and view usage (Enter).

nodes.name: draw_form
nodes.summary: Renders centered modal form for adding/editing a tag. Fields: name (required text), color (hex e.g. #ff0000), description (optional text).

nodes.name: submit_tag_form
nodes.summary: Validates and saves the tag form to the database. Uses TagCreate for new tags and TagUpdate for edits. Refreshes the tags list and shows a success/error notification.

nodes.name: indicators.rs
nodes.summary: TUI screen for browsing and searching extracted IOCs (Indicators of Compromise). Shows a table (68%) and detail panel (32%) split layout. The table displays type, value, reputation, sightings, and last-seen time. The detail panel shows full metadata, enrichment results, and recent occurrence records with surrounding text snippets.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders the indicators screen split into table (68%) and detail panel (32%). Delegates to draw_indicator_table() and draw_indicator_detail().

nodes.name: handle_key
nodes.summary: Routes keyboard events: navigation (j/k), type filter cycling (t), clear type filter (c), queue enrichment (e), refresh (r), and filter (/).

nodes.name: draw_indicator_table
nodes.summary: Renders the indicator list table with columns: Type, Value (truncated to 64 chars), Reputation (from enrichment), Sightings count, Last Seen timestamp.

nodes.name: draw_indicator_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the indicator detail panel showing: type, normalized value, sighting count, confidence score, risk score, first/last seen dates, enrichment reputation and summary, plus up to 6 recent occurrence records with source field and surrounding text.

nodes.name: queue_selected_indicator_enrichment
nodes.summary: Queues enrichment jobs for the currently selected indicator. Checks that enrichment is enabled in settings. Reports job count via notification.

nodes.name: next_type_filter
nodes.summary: Cycles through IOC types (Ipv4 → Ipv6 → Domain → Url → Email → Md5 → Sha1 → Sha256 → Cve → MitreAttackTechnique → OnionDomain → OnionUrl → all) for the type filter.

nodes.name: indicator_type_label
nodes.summary: Maps sentinel_ioc::IndicatorType enum values to human-readable short labels (e.g. Ipv4 → 'IPv4', Cve → 'CVE', CryptoWallet → 'Wallet').

nodes.name: enrichment_reputation_label
nodes.summary: Extracts the best available reputation/verdict string from a list of EnrichmentResultRecord entries. Prefers verdict over reputation; returns 'Unknown' if list is empty.

nodes.name: occurrence_location_label
nodes.summary: Formats an IndicatorOccurrence location label by priority: Alert #id > Content #id > Feed #id > 'Unlinked'.

nodes.name: truncate_chars
nodes.summary: Truncates a string to at most max_chars characters, appending '...' if truncation occurred.

nodes.name: enrichment_queue.rs
nodes.summary: TUI screen for monitoring and processing the IOC enrichment job queue. Displays a table of pending/retried/succeeded enrichment jobs with provider, indicator, type, status, attempt count, next retry time, and last error message.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders the enrichment queue screen: title with job count, job table with status-colored rows, and status bar.

nodes.name: handle_key
nodes.summary: Routes keyboard events: navigation (j/k), process queue (p), refresh (r), filter (/).

nodes.name: process_enrichment_queue
nodes.summary: Launches a single-threaded Tokio runtime and calls enrichment::run_enrichment_once() to process up to 10 queued jobs. Refreshes the queue and indicator screens after completion. Checks that enrichment is enabled.

nodes.name: settings.rs
nodes.summary: TUI screen for application configuration. Three tabs: General (theme, alert retention, IOC/extraction settings, enrichment settings, auto-fetch interval), Notifications (notification channel table with add/edit/delete), and Enrichment (enrichment provider health with toggle, enable/disable, and test).

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders the settings screen with 3 tabs (General, Notifications, Enrichment) and dispatches to the appropriate tab draw function.

nodes.name: draw_general
nodes.summary: Renders the General settings tab showing: current theme, alert retention days, cleanup preview button, IOC extraction toggles, enrichment queueing toggles, and auto-fetch status.

nodes.name: draw_notifications
nodes.summary: Renders the Notifications settings tab with a table of notification channels (name, channel type, minimum criticality, enabled).

nodes.name: draw_enrichment
nodes.summary: Renders the Enrichment settings tab with enrichment provider table showing name, enabled status, API key availability, and health status. Supports toggle/enable/disable/test per provider.

nodes.name: logs.rs
nodes.summary: TUI screen for viewing feed health logs. Displays a chronological table of feed fetch attempts with timestamp, feed name, status (Healthy/Warning/Error/Disabled with color coding), and error message. Supports filtering by feed.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders the logs screen: title with feed filter label, health log table with status-colored status column, and status bar.

nodes.name: handle_key
nodes.summary: Routes keyboard events: navigation (j/k), cycle feed filter (f), clear feed filter (c), refresh (r), filter (/).

nodes.name: list.rs
nodes.summary: Shared reusable utilities for TUI list navigation and rendering. Provides ListMotion enum for typed motion commands, move_selection() for bounds-aware index movement, criticality_label() for human-readable criticality labels, selected_style() for row highlighting, and motion_from_key() for vim-style keyboard mapping.

nodes.name: move_selection
nodes.summary: Moves a selection index in a list by a given motion (Up, Down, Top, Bottom, HalfPageUp, HalfPageDown), respecting list bounds and never returning out-of-range indices.

nodes.name: motion_from_key
nodes.summary: Maps crossterm KeyEvent to ListMotion, handling vim-style bindings: j/Down, k/Up, g (pending, then second g = Top), G = Bottom, Ctrl+d = HalfPageDown(10), Ctrl+u = HalfPageUp(10).

nodes.name: criticality_label
nodes.summary: Returns a monochrome-friendly criticality label: 'L Low', 'M Medium', 'H High', 'C Critical'.

nodes.name: selected_style
nodes.summary: Returns a ratatui Style with REVERSED and BOLD modifiers for highlighting the currently selected row in a stateful widget.

nodes.name: utils.rs
nodes.summary: Miscellaneous UI helper utilities. Currently provides time_ago() for rendering human-readable relative timestamps from UTC DateTime values (e.g. '5m ago', '2d ago', '1mo ago').

nodes.name: time_ago
nodes.summary: Computes the time elapsed since a UTC DateTime and returns a formatted string: <60s → 'Xs ago', <60m → 'Xm ago', <24h → 'Xh ago', <30d → 'Xd ago', else → 'Xmo ago'.

nodes.name: command_palette/mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the command palette feature. Re-exports CommandId, CommandAction, ModalKind, AppAction, CommandPaletteState, and PaletteMode. Provides CommandPalette struct with new() constructor.

nodes.name: CommandPalette
nodes.summary: Top-level struct holding CommandPaletteState. Implements Default for auto-initialization.

nodes.name: command_palette/command.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core command types: CommandId (40+ variants for navigation, feeds, alerts, keywords, doctor, notifications), CommandGroup, CommandAvailability, CommandAction, ModalKind, AppAction, and the Command struct bundling all metadata (canonical name, title, description, aliases, keywords).

nodes.name: CommandId
nodes.summary: Enum of all available command identifiers. Variants cover navigation (OpenDashboard, OpenFeeds, etc.), system (Refresh, Quit), feed operations (FeedAdd, FeedEditSelected, FeedCheckAll, etc.), alert operations (AlertShowUnread, AlertMarkSelectedRead, etc.), keyword operations, doctor checks, and notification tests.

nodes.name: CommandGroup
nodes.summary: Enum grouping commands by category: Navigation, Feed, Alert, Keyword, Doctor, Notification, System. Provides label() to get short display string.

nodes.name: CommandAvailability
nodes.summary: Enum controlling when commands are shown: Always, WhenFeedSelected, WhenAlertSelected, WhenKeywordSelected, WhenNotificationRouteConfigured(NotificationRouteKind). Used for context-aware filtering.

nodes.name: CommandAction
nodes.summary: Enum of actions a command can trigger: Navigate(Screen), OpenModal(ModalKind), Dispatch(AppAction), Quit.

nodes.name: ModalKind
nodes.summary: Enum of modal dialog kinds: Help, Confirm, EditFeed, EditKeyword.

nodes.name: AppAction
nodes.summary: Enum of app-level actions dispatched by commands: Refresh, FeedAdd, FeedCheckAll, AlertMarkSelectedRead, KeywordAdd, DoctorRun, NotifyTestDiscord, etc.

nodes.name: Command
nodes.summary: Struct bundling command metadata: id, canonical name, title, description, group, aliases, keywords, availability, and action. All 40+ commands are defined as static Command instances.

nodes.name: command_palette/registry.rs
nodes.summary: Defines CommandContext (runtime context for availability checking: current screen, selection flags, notification config) and ALL_COMMANDS static array (all 40+ command definitions). Provides available_commands() filter function and is_available() helper.

nodes.name: CommandContext
nodes.summary: Runtime context struct passed to availability checks. Fields: current_screen, has_selected_feed, has_selected_alert, has_selected_keyword, discord/webhook/email_configured. Implements Default.

nodes.name: command_palette/state.rs
nodes.summary: Defines PaletteMode (Fuzzy, Colon) and CommandPaletteState struct managing UI state: is_open, mode, input buffer, selected_index, scroll_offset, results. Provides methods for open/close, input manipulation, navigation, and result refresh.

nodes.name: PaletteMode
nodes.summary: Enum of input modes for the command palette: Fuzzy (prefixed with '>') and Colon (prefixed with ':').

nodes.name: CommandPaletteState
nodes.summary: Struct managing command palette UI state: open/close, mode switching, input handling (char, backspace, clear), selection navigation with scroll offset clamping, and result refresh via matcher. Implements Default.

nodes.name: command_palette/matcher.rs
nodes.summary: Implements fuzzy command matching. normalize_input() strips ':' prefix and lowercases; tokenize() splits on whitespace; match_commands() returns sorted CommandMatch list by score; score_command() computes relevance score (exact canonical=10000, prefix=5000, alias match=2000, etc.)

nodes.name: CommandMatch
nodes.summary: Struct holding a Command reference with its computed match score (i64). Used to rank and sort search results.

nodes.name: normalize_input
nodes.summary: Normalizes user input: trims whitespace, strips leading ':' (for colon mode), lowercases all characters, collapses multiple spaces to single spaces.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Splits normalized input on whitespace into a Vec of token string slices.

nodes.name: match_commands
nodes.summary: Main matching entry point. Normalizes input, tokenizes, scores all commands, sorts by score desc then canonical length asc, returns Vec<CommandMatch>.

nodes.name: score_command
nodes.summary: Computes relevance score for a command given token list. Checks canonical, title, description, aliases, keywords, group. Returns None if any token doesn't match. Scores: exact canonical 10000, canonical prefix 5000, title prefix 4000, all tokens in canonical 3000, all tokens in alias 2000, all tokens in title 1500, all tokens in description 1000, all tokens in keywords 800, all tokens in group 500.

nodes.name: command_palette/render.rs
nodes.summary: Renders the command palette overlay using ratatui. draw() centers a modal dialog (60-100 wide, 12-30 tall), shows input line with '>' or ':' prefix, renders paginated command results with group label, title, and description, highlighting selected row.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.summary: Renders the command palette widget to a ratatui Frame. Calculates centered overlay dimensions, renders input paragraph with mode prefix, renders paginated result list with group labels (in secondary color), titles (highlighted if selected), and descriptions. Shows placeholder text for empty results.

nodes.name: command_palette/tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the command palette module covering: unique CommandId/canonical names, non-empty titles/descriptions, contextual availability filtering, input normalization (strip ':', collapse spaces, lowercase), empty query behavior, search by canonical/alias/keyword, ranking, case insensitivity, multi-token matching, state transitions (open_fuzzy, open_colon, backspace, close, navigation clamping), and selection validity after filtering.

nodes.name: sentinel-ioc/lib.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel file for the sentinel-ioc crate. Exports the public API including IocExtractor, extract_indicators, IgnoreList, and the core types: ExtractedIndicator, ExtractionField, ExtractionInput, IndicatorType.

nodes.name: IndicatorType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of 15 indicator types supported by the IOC extractor: Ipv4, Ipv6, Domain, Url, Email, Md5, Sha1, Sha256, Cve, MitreAttackTechnique, OnionDomain, OnionUrl, CryptoWallet, CloudAccessKey, Unknown.

nodes.name: ExtractionField
nodes.summary: A named text field for IOC extraction. Contains a name and the raw text content to scan for indicators.

nodes.name: ExtractionInput
nodes.summary: Input struct passed to the IOC extractor. Holds optional content_item_id, alert_id, feed_id, and a list of ExtractionField entries to scan.

nodes.name: ExtractedIndicator
nodes.summary: Represents a single extracted IOC. Stores indicator_type, raw value, normalized value, source_field name, byte offsets, surrounding text context, and a confidence hint (0-100).

nodes.name: IocExtractor
nodes.summary: Main IOC extraction engine. Scans text fields using regex patterns for URLs, emails, onion domains, hashes (MD5/SHA1/SHA256), CVEs, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, IPv4, IPv6, and domains. Normalizes and deduplicates matches using a span-tracking approach. Applies an ignore list before returning results.

nodes.name: extract_indicators
nodes.summary: Convenience function that creates a default IocExtractor and extracts indicators from the given ExtractionInput. Returns a Vec<ExtractedIndicator>.

nodes.name: IocExtractor::extract
nodes.summary: Iterates over all ExtractionFields and extracts indicators from each, then filters out any that match the IgnoreList.

nodes.name: IocExtractor::extract_field
nodes.summary: Scans a single ExtractionField using all 11 regex patterns (URL, email, onion, SHA256, SHA1, MD5, CVE, MITRE, IPv4, IPv6, domain). Tracks seen spans to prevent overlapping matches.

nodes.name: IocExtractor::scan_matches
nodes.summary: Generic helper that iterates over regex matches, checks for span overlaps, trims indicators, applies normalization, and appends ExtractedIndicator entries.

nodes.name: overlaps_seen
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given span (start, end) overlaps with any previously seen spans in the HashSet.

nodes.name: surrounding_text
nodes.summary: Extracts text context around an indicator match (±120 characters), clamping to valid UTF-8 character boundaries.

nodes.name: sentinel-ioc/patterns.rs
nodes.summary: Provides 11 lazily-initialized regex patterns for IOC detection: url, email, ipv4, ipv6, sha256, sha1, md5, cve, mitre_technique, onion_domain, domain. Each pattern is compiled once via OnceLock.

nodes.name: url
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching HTTP/HTTPS URLs: r'(?i)\bhttps?://[^\s<>"'`{}|\^]+'

nodes.name: email
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching email addresses (case-insensitive, max 63-char TLD).

nodes.name: ipv4
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching IPv4 addresses in dotted-quad notation.

nodes.name: ipv6
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching IPv6 addresses, including those with zone IDs.

nodes.name: sha256
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching 64-character hexadecimal strings (SHA-256).

nodes.name: sha1
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching 40-character hexadecimal strings (SHA-1).

nodes.name: md5
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching 32-character hexadecimal strings (MD5).

nodes.name: cve
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching CVE identifiers: CVE-YYYY-NNNNN+ (year 0001-9999, ID 4-10 digits).

nodes.name: mitre_technique
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs: TNNNN or TNNNN.NNN.

nodes.name: onion_domain
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching Tor onion domain names (56 base32 characters + .onion).

nodes.name: domain
nodes.summary: Returns a static Regex for matching DNS domain names (2-63 char labels, 2-63 char TLD, max 253 chars total).

nodes.name: sentinel-ioc/normalize.rs
nodes.summary: Normalization functions for IOC values: normalize_ipv4, normalize_ipv6, normalize_domain, normalize_onion_domain, normalize_url, normalize_email, normalize_hash, normalize_cve, normalize_mitre_technique, ip_flags. Also provides trim_indicator and IpFlags struct.

nodes.name: normalize_ipv4
nodes.summary: Parses a dotted-quad IPv4 string, validates each octet is 0-255, and returns the canonical form (e.g., 192.168.001.001 → 192.168.1.1).

nodes.name: normalize_ipv6
nodes.summary: Parses and canonicalizes an IPv6 address using std::net::Ipv6Addr.

nodes.name: normalize_domain
nodes.summary: Lowercases and validates domain names. Rejects localhost, example.com, empty labels, labels > 63 chars, and TLDs that contain non-alpha characters.

nodes.name: normalize_url
nodes.summary: Parses a URL, validates it uses HTTP or HTTPS scheme, lowercases the host, and returns the normalized URL along with its IndicatorType (Url or OnionUrl).

nodes.name: normalize_hash
nodes.summary: Validates a hash string has the expected length (32 for MD5, 40 for SHA-1, 64 for SHA-256) and consists only of hex digits. Returns lowercase form.

nodes.name: normalize_cve
nodes.summary: Validates and normalizes CVE IDs to uppercase. Requires format CVE-YYYY-NNNNN+ where year is 4 digits and ID is 4-10 digits.

nodes.name: ip_flags
nodes.summary: Returns an IpFlags struct for an IP address indicating whether it is private, loopback, multicast, or reserved.

nodes.name: IpFlags
nodes.summary: Struct holding IP classification flags: is_private, is_reserved, is_loopback, is_multicast.

nodes.name: sentinel-ioc/ignore.rs
nodes.summary: IgnoreList struct for filtering extracted indicators. Allows ignoring specific domains, emails, hashes, regex patterns, private IPs, and reserved IPs.

nodes.name: IgnoreList
nodes.summary: Builder-style struct for constructing ignore rules. Stores HashSets for domains, emails, hashes, a Vec of regex patterns, and flags for ignoring private/reserved IPs. Provides is_ignored() to test whether an indicator should be filtered.

nodes.name: sentinel-enrichment/lib.rs
nodes.summary: Core enrichment module. Defines the EnrichmentProvider async trait, Reputation enum, EnrichmentRequest/EnrichmentResult/ProviderConfig structs, and a MockProvider for testing. Exports CisaKevProvider and UrlHausProvider.

nodes.name: EnrichmentProvider
nodes.summary: Async trait for enrichment providers. Providers implement name(), supported_types(), and enrich(). Includes built-in CisaKevProvider and UrlHausProvider implementations.

nodes.name: Reputation
nodes.summary: Enumeration of enrichment reputation levels: Unknown, Benign, Suspicious, Malicious, KnownScanner, KnownPhishing, KnownMalware, KnownC2, KnownRansomware.

nodes.name: EnrichmentRequest
nodes.summary: Request struct sent to an enrichment provider. Contains indicator_id, indicator_type, normalized_value, and provider_name.

nodes.name: EnrichmentResult
nodes.summary: Result struct returned from enrichment. Contains provider_name, indicator_type, normalized_value, reputation, optional score (0-100), verdict, summary, raw JSON, and expires_at timestamp.

nodes.name: ProviderConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for an enrichment provider. Holds enabled flag, optional secret_ref (e.g., env:VAR), rate_limit_per_minute, cache_ttl_hours, and a values HashMap for arbitrary JSON config.

nodes.name: EnrichmentError
nodes.summary: Error enum for enrichment operations: UnsupportedIndicatorType, Disabled, Provider(String). Implements thiserror::Error.

nodes.name: MockProvider
nodes.summary: Test mock for EnrichmentProvider. Builder-pattern struct that returns configurable reputation, score, verdict, and summary. Used in unit tests.

nodes.name: sentinel-enrichment/urlhaus.rs
nodes.summary: URLHaus API enrichment provider. Queries the Abuse.ch URLHaus API for URL, domain, IPv4, MD5, and SHA256 indicators. Returns KnownMalware reputation for positive matches, Unknown for no_results. Supports Auth-Key via config or environment variable.

nodes.name: UrlHausProvider
nodes.summary: Enrichment provider for URLHaus API. Implements EnrichmentProvider. Supports Url, Domain, Ipv4, Md5, Sha256 indicators. Authenticates via Auth-Key header (from config or env:URLHAUS_AUTH_KEY). Scores 90 for active online malware, 75 for listed but inactive.

nodes.name: UrlHausProvider::enrich
nodes.summary: Main enrichment entry point. Builds the appropriate API endpoint and form data based on indicator type, retrieves auth key, makes the HTTP POST request, and maps the response to EnrichmentResult.

nodes.name: UrlHausProvider::auth_key
nodes.summary: Resolves the URLHaus Auth-Key from ProviderConfig values (auth_key field) or secret_ref (env:URLHAUS_AUTH_KEY). Returns an error if the key is missing or empty.

nodes.name: UrlHausProvider::result_from_response
nodes.summary: Maps a URLHaus API JSON response to an EnrichmentResult. Handles query_status values: no_results → Unknown, ok → KnownMalware with score based on url_status (online/offline).

nodes.name: sentinel-enrichment/cisa_kev.rs
nodes.summary: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog enrichment provider. Loads a JSON catalog (from file or string), indexes entries by CVE ID, and returns a Known Exploited verdict for matching CVEs. Supports only CVE indicator type.

nodes.name: CisaKevProvider
nodes.summary: Enrichment provider backed by the CISA KEV JSON catalog. Indexes CVE IDs (uppercase) in a HashMap for O(1) lookup. Returns score 90, reputation Malicious for known exploited CVEs; score 0, reputation Unknown for non-listed CVEs.

nodes.name: CisaKevProvider::from_json_file
nodes.summary: Factory method that loads a CISA KEV JSON catalog from a file path, parses it, and builds the CVE index.

nodes.name: CisaKevProvider::enrich

nodes.name: TemplateEngine::extract_items

nodes.name: TemplateEngine::extract_jsonpath

nodes.name: TemplateEngine::validate_template

nodes.name: notify.rs

nodes.name: NotifyEngine

nodes.name: NotifyEngine::send_for_alert

nodes.name: NotifyEngine::send_email

nodes.name: NotifyEngine::send_webhook

nodes.name: NotifyEngine::send_discord

nodes.name: ALERT_TRIAGE_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for adding a structured Alert Triage Workflow to ThreatDeck. Enables analysts to move alerts through a clear investigation lifecycle: New → Acknowledged → Investigating → Confirmed Threat/False Positive/Benign → Escalated/Closed. Includes MVP scope with triage states (New, Acknowledged, Investigating, Escalated, Closed), dispositions (Unknown, Confirmed Threat, False Positive, Benign, Duplicate, Informational, Needs More Context), and fields like status, disposition, severity, confidence, owner, triage_notes, and triage timestamps. Also covers bulk status updates, triage history log, filtering, and command palette integration.

nodes.name: IOC_ENRICHMENT_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for adding automated IOC (Indicator of Compromise) extraction and enrichment to ThreatDeck. Supports extraction of IPv4/IPv6 addresses, domains, URLs, email addresses, file hashes (MD5, SHA1, SHA256), CVE IDs, MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs, .onion URLs/domains, crypto wallet addresses, and cloud access key patterns. MVP enrichment sources include local enrichment, CISA KEV via local cache, and optional URLHaus API, with future support planned for VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, and GreyNoise. Also covers the sentinel-ioc and sentinel-enrichment crates that have since been implemented as workspace members.

nodes.name: COMMAND_PALETTE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for adding a command palette to ThreatDeck, opened via Ctrl+P or : prefix. Enables fuzzy search and quick execution of ThreatDeck actions like 'feed add', 'alert critical', 'keyword test', 'case create', 'notify test discord'. Covers MVP commands for feeds, alerts, keywords, system health, and notifications. The command palette subsystem has since been implemented in src/ui/command_palette/ with modules for registry, state, matcher, command definitions, rendering, and tests.

nodes.name: MARKDOWN_REPORT_EXPORT_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for adding Markdown report export to ThreatDeck. Supports exporting selected alerts, visible alerts, unread/critical alerts, case reports, indicator packages, feed health reports, and daily summaries. MVP export targets local files and stdout in Markdown format, with future support for JSON, CSV, HTML, PDF, and STIX bundles. The threatdeck-report crate (crates/threatdeck-report/) has since been implemented as a workspace member to handle this feature.

nodes.name: SPEC.md
nodes.summary: The authoritative specification for ThreatDeck v0.4. Defines the Rust data models (FeedType, FeedStatus, Criticality, Keyword, Alert, Tag, NotificationConfig, FeedHealthLog, etc.), the SQLite schema with all tables and indexes, and the full module API surface for db, config, feed (API/RSS/Website/Onion fetchers), template, scheduler, keyword matching, alert generation, tag management, and notifications. Includes TUI architecture, screen specifications for Dashboard/Feeds/Alerts/Keywords/Tags/Logs/Settings, feed health monitoring rules, alert deduplication by SHA256 content hash within a 1-hour window, and demo data seeding.

nodes.name: Command Palette Foundation
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for a self-contained command palette module under src/ui/command_palette/. Defines CommandId, CommandGroup, CommandAvailability, CommandAction, and ModalKind enums; the Command struct with canonical name, aliases, keywords, and availability; a static REGISTRY of all commands organized by group; token-based fuzzy matching with scoring and ranking; CommandPaletteState for mode transitions and input handling; and a render.rs placeholder. Commands cover Navigation, Feed, Alert, Keyword, Doctor, Notification, and System groups. No external fuzzy matching crates — uses standard library only.

nodes.name: Feed Fetch Logging Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Detailed feed observability plan for ThreatDeck that captures the exact failure phase of every feed fetch attempt (UrlValidation, Dns, TcpConnect, TlsHandshake, HttpRequest, HttpStatus, Redirect, BodyDownload, ContentDecode, FeedParse, DatabaseWrite). Proposes FetchFailurePhase and FetchFailureKind enums, a FetchDiagnostic struct, and a feed_fetch_attempts SQLite table with per-attempt history including http_status, elapsed_ms, error_summary, error_detail, and item counts. Also proposes summary columns on the feeds table (last_error_summary, last_error_detail, last_failure_phase, last_failure_kind, last_http_status) for fast UI rendering. Includes reqwest error classification helper and user-friendly diagnosis messaging.

nodes.name: Auto-Fetch Background Thread Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for a background auto-fetch thread in ThreatDeck. The AutoFetcher thread owns a DB connection, sleeps for a configurable interval (default 15 min, range 5–60 min), fetches all enabled feeds sequentially, processes results through AlertEngine, and sends a summary back to the TUI via an mpsc channel. The main event loop polls the channel each tick. Covers AutoFetchConfig in config.rs, AutoFetchMessage enum (Completed/Stopped), AutoFetcher struct with thread::JoinHandle and stop channel, integration into app.rs on_tick, Settings UI for toggle/interval, and graceful shutdown on exit.

nodes.name: Alert Triage Workflow — Expanded Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Expanded alert triage implementation plan addressing codebase-specific gaps discovered during review. Reuses the existing Criticality enum for analyst severity overrides. Adds AlertStatus (New/Acknowledged/Investigating/Escalated/Closed/Reopened), AlertDisposition (Unknown/Unrelated/Informational/ConfirmedThreat), and an alert_triage_events table for audit logging. Proposed schema migration via IF NOT EXISTS ALTER in catalog-updates.sql. Resolves keyboard conflicts by using uppercase letters for triage actions (A/I/E/C/O/N/S/T/H). Details enum selection modal pattern (reusing tag assignment List widget), note input modal, and close flow with disposition selection. Includes TriageConfig in AppConfig, testing strategy (unit/DB/integration), and phased implementation order.

nodes.name: ThreatDeck TUI Design Review
nodes.summary: Comprehensive design review of ThreatDeck's terminal UI. Assesses the screen-switching layout, keyboard interaction model (L0-L3 layers), color/theme system, and accessibility. Rates the TUI C+ and details issues: undiscoverable keybindings, missing `/` search, broken detail views, N+1 queries, no NO_COLOR support, and inconsistent footer text. Proposes a 4-phase implementation roadmap from critical fixes (search, accessibility) through power-user features (command palette, sidebar). Highlights clean module architecture, theme system, and confirmation dialogs as strengths to preserve.

nodes.name: Feed Fetch Diagnostics Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Detailed implementation plan for adding structured feed fetch diagnostics to ThreatDeck. Divides work into 6 chunks: (1) Diagnostic types (FetchFailurePhase, FetchFailureKind, FetchDiagnostic, FetchAttempt) and conservative classifiers using ureq error strings; (2) DB persistence with a new feed_fetch_attempts table, new Feed fields (last_fetch_success_at, last_failure_phase/kind/http_status), and record_feed_fetch_outcome helper that updates feed summary on success/failure; (3) Shared FeedManager::run_fetch_attempt orchestration used by both manual and auto-fetch; (4) TUI Feeds screen updates showing latest attempt and recent attempts list; (5) CLI --debug-feed-id and --check-feed commands with diagnostic report formatter; (6) Verification and polish. All tasks include TDD steps with specific test names and cargo run commands.

nodes.name: Cached Articles Feed Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Implementation plan for adding a cached Articles tab to ThreatDeck. Architecture adds a persistent feed_items table storing all RSS/API items keyed by content_hash, separate from keyword alerting. Chunks: (1) DB schema (feed_items table with id/feed_id/title/url/author/summary/content/published_at/fetched_at/content_hash/read/metadata_json), types (FeedItem, FeedItemWithFeed, NewFeedItem, FeedItemFilter), and Db methods (upsert_feed_item, list_feed_items, get_feed_item, mark_feed_item_read); (2) Articles TUI screen with list view, reader view with HTML-to-plaintext cleanup, keyboard navigation, and read/unread toggle; (3) Integration with feed processing to save normalized items without requiring keyword matches; (4) Docs updates. All tasks include TDD steps.

nodes.name: Feed Fetch Diagnostics MVP Design
nodes.summary: Design specification for the Feed Fetch Diagnostics MVP. Goals: help users understand why a feed fetch failed, where (phase) it failed, and what to try next — without replacing the existing ureq stack. Non-goals: no ureq replacement, no full tracing pipeline, no TLS bypass. Architecture: add src/feed/diagnostics.rs with FetchFailurePhase (12 variants), FetchFailureKind (14 variants), FetchDiagnostic, and FetchAttempt types. Classification uses ureq error type mapping (Status→HttpStatus, Transport→network categories) with conservative string matching on error details. Data model: new feed_fetch_attempts table + 5 new columns on feeds table. Shared FeedManager::run_fetch_attempt orchestration. TUI shows phase/kind in detail modal and recent attempts list. CLI --debug-feed-id and --check-feed. Includes acceptance criteria and testing guidance.
